products.name: Champ de Mars
products.description: Inspired by the Eiffel Tower, the limited-edition Champ de Mars Eiffel timepiece blends Parisian heritage with precision engineering. Its cannage-patterned bezel echoes the tower’s lattice, while a bespoke double-barrel tourbillon, encased in sapphire crystals, powers the skeletonized dial. Housed in a 43mm gun-plated case with polished chamfers and a refined top ring, it boasts a 20-jewel movement with a 65-hour power reserve. A genuine black leather strap adds the final touch of sophistication.

products.name: Champ de Mars
products.description: Champ De Mars watch captures the essence of Parisian elegance. Its unique topring and case, mimicking the intricate patterns of the Eiffel Tower, oozes a timeless allure. With a 43 mm rose gold and black case, the see-through dial prominently features the signature Saint Honoré Paris at the center. Complemented by a luxurious croco printed black leather strap, the Champ De Mars watch is a perfect blend of style and heritage.
